evidence: Diagnostics show a material temporal drift with a validation positive rate delta of -0.023 compared to training. Previous scalar experiments attempting to calibrate this via BCE/BPR loss weights (E0013-E0015) destabilized training and inverted predictions.
expected_effect: Incorporating the training-fitted date boundaries will explicitly provide the model with time-based features, allowing it to adapt to temporal distribution shifts and calibrate its rankings without destabilizing the BPR loss landscape.
hypothesis: Adding the date_period_bucket operator during the feature stage will capture temporal baseline shifts, improving validation ranking metrics relative to the static baseline.
